title: A Finite Bid--Ask Spread from Replenishment Displaced from the Quote
abstract: arXiv:2610.07985v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We give a unified analytic account of a finite bid--ask spread in a two-field reaction--diffusion order book. The model retains separate bid and ask densities in operational time, with diffusion, cancellation, reaction and external order creation. On the symmetric equal-coefficient branch, the imbalance field determines the reaction price, while the total standing density carries the spread geometry. A market-making source is introduced by withholding order placement over a finite interval around the reaction boundary, representing round-trip replenishment displaced from the quote. Under a separated, quasistationary and weak-overlap approximation, transport penetrates inward from the placement edges over the cancellation length, giving the quoted spread as the sub-threshold core of the placement-source-free interval. translated_title: 由偏离报价的补货机制产生的有限买卖价差
translated_abstract: 我们在双场反应-扩散订单簿模型中对有限买卖价差给出了统一的分析性刻画。该模型在操作时间里保留独立的买方与卖方密度，包含扩散、撤单、反应以及外部订单生成等过程。在对称等系数分支上，失衡场决定反应价格，而总挂单密度承载价差的几何结构。通过在反应边界附近一段有限区间内扣留订单投放，引入了一个做市源，用以表示从报价处位移开来的往返补货。在分离变量、拟稳态及弱重叠近似下，输运过程从投放边缘向内穿透一个撤单长度，由此得到的报价价差即为无投放源区间的亚阈值核心部分。市价订单在观测报价处移除挂单密度，而补货则在报价之外交付，必须通过扩散……
tldr: 该论文在双场反应-扩散订单簿模型中，通过将做市补货从报价处位移引入，在拟稳态和弱重叠近似下解析推导出有限的买卖价差。
en_tdlr: This paper analytically derives a finite bid-ask spread in a two-field reaction-diffusion order book by introducing market-making replenishment displaced away from the quote, under separated, quasistationary and weak-overlap approximations.
